Update System & Core Packages

Ensure the local package index is updated and all existing software is upgraded before adding new packages.

apt update && apt upgrade -y

Comprehensive installation list for productivity, media, and document management:

apt install -y sudo i3 xorg xterm brightnessctl mousepad feh thunar speedtest-cli pavucontrol flatpak libreoffice-writer libreoffice-calc libreoffice-impress libreoffice-draw mpv simplescreenrecorder xfce4-screenshooter ocrmypdf telegram-desktop lollypop gimp foliate qbittorrent persepolis dbus-user-session xdg-user-dirs xdg-desktop-portal xdg-desktop-portal-gtk fonts-noto-cjk fonts-wqy-zenhei fonts-wqy-microhei fonts-arphic-uming fonts-arphic-ukai firefox-esr engrampa pspp xfce4-power-manager papirus-icon-theme lxappearance gnome-disk-utility network-manager network-manager-gnome evince ristretto system-config-printer cups pa-applet libreoffice-gtk3 gnome-themes-extra adwaita-icon-theme adwaita-qt adwaita-qt6 qt5ct qgnomeplatform-qt5 dconf-cli libglib2.0-bin libreoffice-style-elementary -y

User Account & Sudo Configuration

Add your user account to the sudo group:

usermod -aG sudo ejmevardo

Passwordless Power Management

sudo visudo

Append the following line to the end of the file:

# Allow passwordless power commands for ejmevardo user
ejmevardo ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /sbin/shutdown, /sbin/poweroff, /sbin/reboot

Flatpak & Flathub Support

sudo flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo

Reboot Session

sudo reboot

Initialization of Custom Scripts

Ensure scripts for session initialization and system dialogs are executable:

chmod +x ~/.xinitrc && chmod +x ~/.config/i3/scripts/lock_and_dim.sh && chmod +x ~/.config/i3/scripts/exit_dialog.sh

Mounting the Extended Data Partition

Locate the correct partition via sudo blkid, then create the mount point:

sudo mkdir -p /mnt/Extended
sudo chown ejmevardo:ejmevardo /mnt/Extended
sudo chmod 755 /mnt/Extended

Update /etc/fstab for permanent mounting:

LABEL=Extended /mnt/Extended ext4 defaults,errors=remount-ro,user,exec 0 2
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo mount -a

Interface & Icon Theming

Global Dark Mode

gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme 'Adwaita-dark'
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme 'Adwaita-dark'
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme 'prefer-dark'

Lxappearance & Papirus-Dark Icons

Open lxappearance and apply the following:

  • Widget: Adwaita-dark
  • Icon Theme: Papirus-Dark

Power Management & Visual Cues

  • On Battery: Screen dims to 50% at 30 seconds.
  • Plugged In: Screen dims to 20% at 10 seconds.
Move the mouse to reset the timer if the screen dims while reading.

Specific Application Configuration

LibreOffice

  • Tools > Options > LibreOffice:View > Icon Theme: Elementary
  • Tools > Options > LibreOffice: Appearance > Customizations: Items: Color: Light Gray 5
  • Tools > Options > LibreOffice Writer: General > Settings: Measurement units: Inches

Mousepad

Check Wrap Long Lines in Preferences > View.

Combined Audio for Screen Recording

pactl load-module module-null-sink sink_name=Combined_Audio format=s16le channels=2 rate=48000 sink_properties=device.description="Combined_Audio_for_Recording"

Loop back the microphone:

pactl load-module module-loopback source=[YOUR_MIC_SOURCE] sink=Combined_Audio

Fix Thunar "Open Terminal Here" (Custom Action)

If you encounter "permission denied" errors, add this custom action to Thunar:

1. Access Custom Actions:

Go to Edit > Configure Custom Actions...

2. Configure the Action:

Click (+) and fill in:

  • Name: Open New Terminal Here
  • Command: 
    sh -c "cd %f && exec xterm"
3. Set Appearance Conditions:

Under the "Appearance Conditions" tab, leave pattern as * and check Directory.

4. Save and Test:

Click OK. Right-click in any folder to test "Open New Terminal Here".
